verdict.rationale: Trello covers basic work breakdown through checklists, including due dates on checklist items (trello-docs-30, trello-comm-14), and offers a 'Link cards' feature (trello-docs-33). Nothing shows that linked cards carry dependency or blocking semantics, so the blocking-order half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: true dependency/blocking relationships between cards, any visualization of blocking order, in-depth docs on subtasks and linking, and independent hands-on corroboration.
